user_period_engagement_sums.name: user_period_engagement_sums
user_period_engagement_sums.body_sql:
SELECT
  e.user_pseudo_id AS user_pseudo_id,
  -- period_label is left as a column to be filled/filtered by downstream queries;
  -- use NULL as placeholder so this view remains generic (caller should supply/replace).
  NULL AS period_label,
  COALESCE(SUM(
    -- engagement_time_msec is stored in event_params with key 'engagement_time_msec'
    -- Unnest event_params and extract numeric value from the appropriate field.
    -- Prefer int_value, then double_value/float_value, then try to parse string_value as INT64.
    (SELECT
       COALESCE(
         p.value.int_value,
         CAST(p.value.double_value AS INT64),
         CAST(p.value.float_value AS INT64),
         SAFE_CAST(p.value.string_value AS INT64)
       )
     FROM UNNEST(e.event_params) AS p
     WHERE p.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
     LIMIT 1)
  ), 0) AS engagement_time_msec_sum
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` AS e
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
GROUP BY
  e.user_pseudo_id
user_period_engagement_sums.description: Aggregate total engagement_time_msec per user_pseudo_id and period_label. Period_label is a generic column representing an arbitrary period identifier (e.g., '7d' or '2d') to be applied by the final query; rows are one per user_per_period with sum of engagement_time_msec (treating NULLs as 0).

users_who_purchased_product_cohort.name: users_who_purchased_product_cohort
users_who_purchased_product_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fullVisitorId, ''), NULLIF(userId, '')) AS canonical_visitor_id,
  MIN(visitStartTime) AS first_purchase_visitStartTime,
  MIN(hit.hitNumber) AS first_purchase_hitNumber
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS hit,
  UNNEST(hit.product) AS product
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND product.v2ProductName = @product_name
  AND (SAFE_CAST(product.productQuantity AS INT64) IS NOT NULL OR TRUE) -- preserve rows; quantity not required
  AND hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL OR product.productSKU IS NOT NULL -- consider purchase-related hits
GROUP BY
  canonical_visitor_id
users_who_purchased_product_cohort.description: Cohort of distinct users (by canonical_visitor_id, using fullVisitorId when present else userId) who in July 2017 had at least one purchase/hit row with an exact product_name match to a provided product-name parameter. One row per user identifier.

monthly_source_revenue.name: monthly_source_revenue
monthly_source_revenue.body_sql:
SELECT
  trafficSource.source AS trafficSource_source,
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date)) AS session_month,
  SUM(totals.transactionRevenue) AS monthly_transaction_revenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
GROUP BY
  trafficSource.source,
  session_month
monthly_source_revenue.description: For each trafficSource.source and calendar month in 2017, compute the total transaction revenue by summing session-level transaction revenue across sessions. Produce one row per source-month for later ranking and difference calculations.

yearly_source_revenue.name: yearly_source_revenue
yearly_source_revenue.body_sql:
SELECT
  ts.source AS trafficSource_source,
  SUM(IFNULL(totals.transactionRevenue, 0)) AS yearly_total_transaction_revenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s
CROSS JOIN UNNEST([s.trafficSource]) AS ts
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
GROUP BY
  trafficSource_source
yearly_source_revenue.description: For each trafficSource.source compute the total transaction revenue for the entire year 2017 by summing session-level revenues across all months. This produces one row per traffic source with its yearly total, to determine the top source.

visitor_first_dates_feb2017.name: visitor_first_dates_feb2017
visitor_first_dates_feb2017.body_sql:
SELECT
  fullVisitorId,
  -- earliest session date (YYYYMMDD) in Feb 2017 for this visitor, NULL if none
  MIN(CASE WHEN _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228' THEN date END) AS first_visit_date_feb2017,
  -- earliest session date (YYYYMMDD) in Feb 2017 for this visitor that has a transaction (totals.transactions > 0 or any hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL)
  -- We check both totals.transactions and presence of a hit.transaction.transactionId to be safe.
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
        AND (
          (totals.transactions IS NOT NULL AND totals.transactions > 0)
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h WHERE h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
          )
        )
      THEN date
    END
  ) AS first_transaction_date_feb2017
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
GROUP BY
  fullVisitorId
visitor_first_dates_feb2017.description: For each visitor (fullVisitorId) compute the earliest session date in February 2017 (first visit date) and the earliest session date that contains a transaction (first transaction date). This uses session-level rows and transaction-session rows; results are one row per visitor with both earliest dates.

session_row_canonicalized.name: session_row_canonicalized
session_row_canonicalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- date as provided (string YYYYMMDD in shard)
  date,
  -- keep fullVisitorId (string)
  fullVisitorId,
  -- canonicalize pageviews: totals.pageviews -> NULL -> 0
  COALESCE(totals.pageviews, 0) AS pageviews,
  -- keep transactions (may be NULL)
  totals.transactions AS transactions,
  -- keep raw hits array for downstream productRevenue checks
  hits
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  -- only include the requested date range across shards (lift literals out of view;
  -- leave placeholder comment so callers supply _TABLE_SUFFIX filter in queries that use this view)
  TRUE
  -- Exclude rows with NULL fullVisitorId as requested
  AND fullVisitorId IS NOT NULL
session_row_canonicalized.description: One canonical row per raw session (one row per ga_sessions_<date> shard row) with cleaned/normalized columns: parse/keep date, fullVisitorId, totals.pageviews as pageviews (NULL->0), totals.transactions, and keep hits array for productRevenue checks. Exclude rows with NULL fullVisitorId at this stage.

monthly_visitor_pageviews_by_group.name: monthly_visitor_pageviews_by_group
monthly_visitor_pageviews_by_group.body_sql:
SELECT
  FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m', TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(CAST(SAFE_CAST(visitStartTime AS INT64) AS INT64))) AS month,
  trafficSource.medium AS `group`,
  fullVisitorId,
  SUM(IFNULL(totals.pageviews, 0)) AS visitor_total_pageviews
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  AND trafficSource.medium IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  month,
  `group`,
  fullVisitorId
monthly_visitor_pageviews_by_group.description: For each month (derived from session date as YYYY-MM), group (classification), and visitor (fullVisitorId), sum pageviews across that visitor's sessions in that month/group. Exclude sessions with NULL classification. Produces one row per month, group, and fullVisitorId with the visitor's total pageviews in that month/group.

product_monthly_quantity_totals.name: product_monthly_quantity_totals
product_monthly_quantity_totals.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.v2ProductName AS item_productName,
  SUM(IFNULL(p.productQuantity, 0)) AS total_quantity
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  item_productName
product_monthly_quantity_totals.description: For each productName (canonical string), total summed item quantities across the provided set of purchases (intended to be applied to purchases_by_qualifying_visitors). This produces one row per product with its total quantity in the cohort.

monthly_product_action_counts.name: monthly_product_action_counts
monthly_product_action_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m', TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(CAST(hit_time AS INT64))) AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hit_event_category = 'Product' AND hit_event_action = 'Detail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS product_detail_pageviews,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hit_event_category = 'Ecommerce' AND hit_event_action = 'AddToCart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_to_cart_actions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hit_event_category = 'Ecommerce' AND hit_event_action = 'Purchase' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_actions
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
CROSS JOIN UNNEST([STRUCT(
  h.time AS hit_time,
  IFNULL(h.eventInfo.eventCategory, '') AS hit_event_category,
  IFNULL(h.eventInfo.eventAction, '') AS hit_event_action,
  IFNULL(h.type, '') AS hit_type
)]) AS hit
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  AND hit_type = 'EVENT'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
monthly_product_action_counts.description: Aggregate counts of product occurrences by month (YYYY-MM) for each action flag. Produces integer counts per month for product detail pageviews, add-to-cart actions, and purchase actions. Does not compute rates.

session_transaction_flags.name: session_transaction_flags
session_transaction_flags.body_sql:
SELECT
  fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  visitorId,
  date AS session_date,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
    WHERE (h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL)
       OR (SAFE_CAST(h.transaction.transactionRevenue AS INT64) > 0)
  ) AS has_transaction_hit,
  device.deviceCategory AS device_deviceCategory
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
session_transaction_flags.description: Normalize session-level indicators: for each session (visitId) indicate whether the session contains any transaction event (a hit where hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL OR hit.transaction.transactionRevenue > 0) and expose the session date and device.deviceCategory. This produces one row per session with boolean flag and session-level relevant fields.

canonical_user_identifier_per_session.name: canonical_user_identifier_per_session
canonical_user_identifier_per_session.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical_user_id: prefer fullVisitorId when present, else string(visitorId)
  COALESCE(fullVisitorId, CAST(visitorId AS STRING)) AS canonical_user_id,
  -- visit_date: use the date string from the shard row
  date AS visit_date,
  -- visit_start_time: keep visitStartTime
  visitStartTime AS visit_start_time,
  -- time_on_site: totals.timeOnSite (may be NULL)
  totals.timeOnSite AS time_on_site,
  -- new_visits_flag: totals.newVisits (INT64) -> treat non-NULL and >0 as 1, else 0
  CASE
    WHEN totals.newVisits IS NOT NULL AND totals.newVisits > 0 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS new_visits_flag,
  -- visit_number: visitNumber
  visitNumber AS visit_number,
  -- transactions_count: totals.transactions (INT64, may be NULL)
  totals.transactions AS transactions_count,
  -- has_transaction_id: whether any hit has a transaction.transactionId present (boolean -> INT64)
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
      WHERE h.transaction IS NOT NULL
        AND h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
        AND h.transaction.transactionId != ''
    ) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS has_transaction_id,
  -- transaction_revenue: coalesce of totals.transactionRevenue and max hit.transaction.transactionRevenue
  COALESCE(
    totals.transactionRevenue,
    (SELECT MAX(h.transaction.transactionRevenue) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h WHERE h.transaction IS NOT NULL)
  ) AS transaction_revenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
canonical_user_identifier_per_session.description: Normalize session rows to produce a canonical user identifier (prefer fullVisitorId, fallback to visitorId) and canonical typed session attributes (date, visit_start_time, totals.timeOnSite, totals.newVisits, visitNumber, totals.transactions). One row per raw session.

later_sessions_with_purchase_flags.name: later_sessions_with_purchase_flags
later_sessions_with_purchase_flags.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- carry canonical user id (use fullVisitorId as canonical_user_id)
  fullVisitorId AS canonical_user_id,
  -- visit date and start time
  date AS visit_date,
  visitStartTime AS visit_start_time,
  -- flag if session contains any purchase: check totals.transactions, any hit.transaction.transactionId present, or any hit.transaction.transactionRevenue > 0
  (CASE
    WHEN IFNULL(totals.transactions, 0) > 0 THEN TRUE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
      WHERE SAFE_CAST(h.transaction.transactionId AS STRING) IS NOT NULL
        AND h.transaction.transactionId != ""
    ) THEN TRUE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
      WHERE IFNULL(h.transaction.transactionRevenue, 0) > 0
         OR IFNULL(h.item.itemRevenue, 0) > 0
    ) THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END) AS is_purchase_session
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
later_sessions_with_purchase_flags.description: All sessions (per user) that occur after a given reference session date/start-time, annotated with flags indicating whether that session contains any purchase (transactions_count > 0 or has_transaction_id = true or transaction_revenue > 0). One row per session per user.

inpatient_charges_2014_rows.name: inpatient_charges_2014_rows
inpatient_charges_2014_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  provider_city AS provider_city,
  total_discharges,
  average_total_payments,
  -- provide a stable row identifier to keep view joinable
  CONCAT(drugrid) AS row_id
FROM (
  SELECT
    drg_definition,
    provider_city,
    total_discharges,
    average_total_payments,
    -- create a deterministic per-row id from shard suffix + provider + drg + discharges + payments
    CONCAT(_TABLE_SUFFIX, '|', IFNULL(provider_id,''), '|', IFNULL(drg_definition,''), '|', IFNULL(CAST(total_discharges AS STRING),''), '|', IFNULL(CAST(average_total_payments AS STRING),'')) AS drugrid
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
    AND drg_definition IS NOT NULL
    AND provider_city IS NOT NULL
    AND total_discharges IS NOT NULL
    AND average_total_payments IS NOT NULL
)
inpatient_charges_2014_rows.description: Subset of inpatient charges limited to the 2014 shard with non-null DRG, provider city, total discharges, and average total payments.

drg_total_discharges_2014.name: drg_total_discharges_2014
drg_total_discharges_2014.body_sql:
SELECT
  drg_definition,
  SUM(total_discharges) AS drg_total_discharges
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
GROUP BY
  drg_definition
drg_total_discharges_2014.description: Total discharges aggregated by DRG definition across all providers/cities for 2014.

drg_city_totals_2014.name: drg_city_totals_2014
drg_city_totals_2014.body_sql:
SELECT
  ic.drg_definition AS drg_definition,
  ic.provider_city AS provider_city,
  SUM(ic.total_discharges) AS city_total_discharges,
  SUM(ic.total_discharges * ic.average_total_payments) AS city_weighted_payments_numerator
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*` AS ic
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
GROUP BY
  ic.drg_definition,
  ic.provider_city
drg_city_totals_2014.description: For each DRG and provider city in 2014, compute the city's total discharges and the weighted sum component needed to compute weighted average of average_total_payments using total_discharges as weights.

persons_with_state.name: persons_with_state
persons_with_state.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.person_id AS person_id,
  l.state AS state
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` AS p
LEFT JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.location` AS l
ON
  p.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE
  l.state IS NOT NULL
persons_with_state.description: Associate each person to their location state by joining person to location, producing one row per person with their state. Exclude persons with NULL state.

drug_exposures_2014_cohort.name: drug_exposures_2014_cohort
drug_exposures_2014_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  drug_exposure_id,
  person_id,
  drug_concept_id,
  drug_exposure_start_date
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure`
WHERE
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM drug_exposure_start_date) = 2014
drug_exposures_2014_cohort.description: All drug_exposure rows whose drug_exposure_start_date falls in calendar year 2014. Keep original drug_exposure fields for later joins and counting. (No aggregation here.)

concept_names.name: concept_names
concept_names.description: Lookup human-readable concept names for drug concept ids by selecting concept_id and concept_name from the concept table. Intended for left-joining to counts; missing concepts will yield NULL names.

outpatient_provider_payments_2014.name: outpatient_provider_payments_2014
outpatient_provider_payments_2014.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_name,
  average_total_payments,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS _table_suffix,
  CONCAT(_TABLE_SUFFIX, '_', CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY _TABLE_SUFFIX ORDER BY provider_id, COALESCE(provider_name, '')) AS STRING)) AS row_id
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
  AND provider_id IS NOT NULL
outpatient_provider_payments_2014.description: Rows from outpatient charges shards restricted to year 2014, keeping provider identifier, provider name, and the numeric average_total_payments for that provider per source row; exclude rows with NULL provider_id.
counter_examples: Can you tell me which healthcare provider incurs the highest combined average costs for both outpatient and inpatient services in 2014?

provider_yearly_average_payments.name: provider_yearly_average_payments
provider_yearly_average_payments.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  -- prefer a non-null provider_name; leave literal selection to the caller by allowing NULLs if none present
  ANY_VALUE(provider_name) AS provider_name,
  SUM(average_total_payments) AS total_average_total_payments
FROM
  -- placeholder for a single-year payments relation (inpatient or outpatient). 
  -- Callers should replace the FROM line with the concrete relation, e.g.:
  --   `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  -- or the wildcard selection constrained to a single _TABLE_SUFFIX for a year.
  UNNEST([STRUCT('REPLACE_ME_PROVIDER_ID' AS provider_id, NULL AS provider_name, 0.0 AS average_total_payments)]) AS payments
GROUP BY
  provider_id
provider_yearly_average_payments.description: Per provider aggregate of average_total_payments within a given input payments relation (e.g., outpatient or inpatient) producing one row per provider with the summed average_total_payments for that relation and the provider_name (prefer any non-null name). This is reusable for outpatient or inpatient inputs for a single year.

provider_combined_payments_2014.name: provider_combined_payments_2014
provider_combined_payments_2014.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(o.provider_id, i.provider_id) AS provider_id,
  COALESCE(o.provider_name, i.provider_name) AS provider_name,
  COALESCE(o.outpatient_average_total_payments_2014, 0.0) AS outpatient_average_total_payments_2014,
  COALESCE(i.inpatient_average_total_payments_2014, 0.0) AS inpatient_average_total_payments_2014,
  COALESCE(o.outpatient_average_total_payments_2014, 0.0) + COALESCE(i.inpatient_average_total_payments_2014, 0.0) AS combined_average_total_payments_2014
FROM (
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    provider_name,
    AVG(average_total_payments) AS outpatient_average_total_payments_2014
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
) o
FULL JOIN (
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    provider_name,
    AVG(average_medicare_payments) AS inpatient_average_total_payments_2014
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2014'
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
) i
ON o.provider_id = i.provider_id
provider_combined_payments_2014.description: Denormalize outpatient and inpatient per-provider aggregates for the same year by joining on provider_id; treat missing side as zero so every provider present in either side appears once with both outpatient and inpatient totals and a combined sum.

person_location.name: person_location
person_location.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.person_id AS person_id,
  p.location_id AS location_id,
  l.state AS state
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` AS p
LEFT JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.location` AS l
ON
  p.location_id = l.location_id
person_location.description: Map each person to their residence location and state. One row per person with location info to enable state-level analysis.

drug_exposures_2014.name: drug_exposures_2014
drug_exposures_2014.body_sql:
SELECT
  drug_exposure_id,
  person_id,
  drug_concept_id,
  drug_source_value,
  drug_exposure_start_date
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure`
WHERE
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM drug_exposure_start_date) = 2014
drug_exposures_2014.description: All drug_exposure records that start in calendar year 2014, retaining core identifiers and dates. This represents the cohort of drug exposures in 2014.

provider_total_inpatient_cost_by_row.name: provider_total_inpatient_cost_by_row
provider_total_inpatient_cost_by_row.body_sql:
SELECT
  provider_name,
  provider_id,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS year,
  -- per-row inpatient cost = average_medicare_payments * total_discharges
  SAFE_MULTIPLY(average_medicare_payments, CAST(total_discharges AS FLOAT64)) AS inpatient_cost
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
grain: one row per provider_id, year, inpatient_cost
provider_total_inpatient_cost_by_row.description: Normalize inpatient rows to include a computed per-row inpatient_cost = average_medicare_payments * total_discharges, preserving provider and year at row level. No temporal filtering beyond the supplied rows; expects input rows from provider_inpatient_rows_2011_2015.

icd10cm_base_concepts.name: icd10cm_base_concepts
icd10cm_base_concepts.body_sql:
SELECT
  concept_id,
  concept_code,
  concept_name,
  vocabulary_id,
  standard_concept
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept`
WHERE
  vocabulary_id = 'ICD10CM'
  AND standard_concept = 'S'
  -- Exclude non-canonical placeholder codes if any: codes that are not alphanumeric ICD-10 patterns can be filtered by callers if needed
icd10cm_base_concepts.description: One row per ICD-10-CM standard concept that represents a base disease concept (canonical ICD-10-CM code). This selects standard concepts from the concept table for ICD-10-CM vocabulary; it is a reusable set of base ICD-10-CM concept rows to be expanded to descendants later.

icd10cm_descendant_concepts.name: icd10cm_descendant_concepts
icd10cm_descendant_concepts.body_sql:
SELECT
  ca.ancestor_concept_id AS ancestor_concept_id,
  ca.descendant_concept_id AS descendant_concept_id
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor` AS ca
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` AS c
ON
  ca.ancestor_concept_id = c.concept_id
WHERE
  c.vocabulary_id = 'ICD10CM'
icd10cm_descendant_concepts.description: One row per concept_id that is either a base ICD-10-CM concept or any descendant concept reachable via concept_ancestor. Expands a set of base ICD-10-CM concept_ids to the full set of included concept_ids (no restriction on distance).

person_condition_occurrence.name: person_condition_occurrence
person_condition_occurrence.body_sql:
SELECT
  condition_occurrence_id,
  person_id,
  condition_concept_id,
  condition_start_date,
  condition_end_date,
  condition_type_concept_id
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence`
person_condition_occurrence.description: One row per condition_occurrence event (mapping of a person to a condition concept). Provides person_id linked to condition_concept_id and event-level attributes; used to identify persons who had any occurrence of a concept in a target set.

distinct_persons.name: distinct_persons
distinct_persons.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.person_id
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` AS p
GROUP BY
  p.person_id
distinct_persons.description: One row per distinct person in the dataset (the universe for percentage calculations).
counter_examples: Please tell me the percentage of participants not using quinapril and related medications(Quinapril RxCUI: 35208).

person_drug_era_usage.name: person_drug_era_usage
person_drug_era_usage.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.person_id AS person_id,
  de.drug_era_id AS drug_era_id,
  de.drug_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_era` AS de
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` AS p
ON
  de.person_id = p.person_id
person_drug_era_usage.description: Drug_era rows joined to persons where drug_concept_id indicates exposure; includes one row per person-drug_era occurrence to determine whether a person has any exposure to target drugs.

persons_with_target_drug_exposure.name: persons_with_target_drug_exposure
persons_with_target_drug_exposure.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.person_id AS person_id,
  -- TRUE if no drug_era exists for this person with a drug_concept_id in the quinapril descendant set
  NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_era` de
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor` ca
      ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = @QUINAPRIL_CONCEPT_ID
      AND ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    WHERE de.person_id = p.person_id
  ) AS has_target_drug_exposure
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person` p
persons_with_target_drug_exposure.description: One row per person_id indicating existence of any drug_era whose drug_concept_id matches the quinapril descendant set (including quinapril itself).

atlantic_season_storm_points.name: atlantic_season_storm_points
atlantic_season_storm_points.body_sql:
SELECT
  sid,
  name,
  season,
  basin,
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
WHERE
  basin = 'NA'
  AND latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  AND iso_time IS NOT NULL
atlantic_season_storm_points.description: All recorded track points for storms in the North Atlantic basin across all seasons, excluding rows with NULL latitude, longitude, or iso_time. This is a row-level cohort of raw storm location observations.

storm_latest_point.name: storm_latest_point
storm_latest_point.body_sql:
SELECT
  sid,
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude
FROM (
  SELECT
    sid,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
)
WHERE rn = 1
storm_latest_point.description: For each storm (sid), pick the single latest recorded track point (maximum iso_time) with its latitude and longitude to represent the storm's final recorded position.

storm_point_pair_distances.name: storm_point_pair_distances
storm_point_pair_distances.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- join key / storm id
  s.sid AS sid,
  -- current point time and location
  s.iso_time AS iso_time,
  s.latitude AS latitude,
  s.longitude AS longitude,
  -- requested existing field
  s.usa_wind AS usa_wind,
  -- previous point time and location (lagged)
  LAG(s.iso_time) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sid ORDER BY s.iso_time) AS prev_iso_time,
  LAG(s.latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sid ORDER BY s.iso_time) AS prev_latitude,
  LAG(s.longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sid ORDER BY s.iso_time) AS prev_longitude,
  -- geodesic distance (kilometers) between current point and previous point
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(s.latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sid ORDER BY s.iso_time) IS NULL
      OR LAG(s.longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sid ORDER BY s.iso_time) IS NULL
    THEN NULL
    ELSE
      -- Use BigQuery GEOGRAPHY functions: compute ST_DISTANCE between points (meters) then convert to km
      ST_DISTANCE(
        ST_GEOGPOINT(s.longitude, s.latitude),
        ST_GEOGPOINT(LAG(s.longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sid ORDER BY s.iso_time),
                     LAG(s.latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sid ORDER BY s.iso_time))
      ) / 1000.0
  END AS distance_to_prev_km
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` AS s
storm_point_pair_distances.description: For each storm (sid) order track points by iso_time and compute the geodesic distance between each point and the previous point (kilometers). Keeps one row per track point with lagged previous point coordinates and the point-to-previous distance.

storm_events_raw_by_shard.name: storm_events_raw_by_shard
storm_events_raw_by_shard.body_sql:
SELECT
  event_id,
  event_begin_time,
  state AS state
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_*`
WHERE
  -- lift shard range literal out of the view; caller should filter _TABLE_SUFFIX between desired years
  TRUE
storm_events_raw_by_shard.description: Raw storm event rows selected from all storm shards. Includes event timestamp and state abbreviation as recorded on each event; no aggregation. Intended to be a straightforward row-level filter/cohort over the storms_* shards.

storm_events_normalized.name: storm_events_normalized
storm_events_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.event_id AS event_id,
  -- derive event_year from event_begin_time in the event's recorded timezone:
  -- event_begin_time is a DATETIME without zone; event_timezone holds zone name like 'EST' etc in original table.
  -- We convert by assuming event_begin_time is in the named timezone and cast to TIMESTAMP then extract year in that timezone.
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(
    -- interpret DATETIME in the given zone; safe fallback to UTC when timezone is NULL/empty
    TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(r.event_begin_time AS STRING), ' UTC')), 
    YEAR
  )) AS event_year,
  -- canonical 2-letter state abbreviation: map full state name to USPS code using simple CASE for common states.
  -- If not matched, return NULL to keep view generic (literals should be lifted out of queries).
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(r.state) IN ('alabama','ala.','ala') THEN 'AL'
    WHEN LOWER(r.state) IN ('alaska','ak') THEN 'AK'
    WHEN LOWER(r.state) IN ('arizona','az') THEN 'AZ'

    WHEN LOWER(r.state) IN ('north carolina','nc') THEN 'NC'

storm_events_normalized.description: Normalized projection of raw storm events: canonical state abbreviation (2-letter), and derived event year from event_begin_time in the event's recorded timezone. Keeps one row per event with cleaned/typed columns.

station_day_valid_temperature_flags.name: station_day_valid_temperature_flags
station_day_valid_temperature_flags.body_sql:
SELECT
  stn,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0'))) AS date,
  NULLIF( CASE WHEN temp = 9999.9 THEN NULL ELSE temp END, NULL) AS temp,
  NULLIF( CASE WHEN max = 9999.9 THEN NULL ELSE max END, NULL) AS max,
  NULLIF( CASE WHEN min = 9999.9 THEN NULL ELSE min END, NULL) AS min,
  CASE
    WHEN temp IS NULL THEN FALSE
    WHEN temp = 9999.9 THEN FALSE
    ELSE TRUE
  END AS is_temp_valid
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
station_day_valid_temperature_flags.description: Canonical normalized indicator per station-day whether the daily observation has valid (non-null / non-missing) temperature, max, and min values. Does not apply question-specific thresholds or date filters beyond canonicalizing missing values.

station_daily_observations_raw.name: station_daily_observations_raw
station_daily_observations_raw.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.usaf AS usaf,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(g.year, LPAD(g.mo,2,'0'), LPAD(g.da,2,'0'))) AS date,
  -- temperature: use 'temp' field (mean daily temp in F) but treat missing 9999.9 as NULL
  CASE WHEN g.temp IS NULL OR g.temp = 9999.9 THEN NULL ELSE g.temp END AS temperature,
  -- wind_speed: use 'wdsp' field (mean wind speed in knots to tenths). Field is STRING in DDL, cast and treat 999.9/9999.9 as NULL
  CASE
    WHEN g.wdsp IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(g.wdsp AS FLOAT64) IN (999.9, 9999.9) THEN NULL
    ELSE SAFE_CAST(g.wdsp AS FLOAT64)
  END AS wind_speed,
  -- precipitation: use 'prcp' field (in inches and hundredths). Missing = 99.99 -> treat as NULL
  CASE WHEN g.prcp IS NULL OR g.prcp = 99.99 THEN NULL ELSE g.prcp END AS precipitation
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS g
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
ON
  g.stn = s.usaf
  AND (g.wban = s.wban OR (g.wban IS NULL AND s.wban IS NULL))
WHERE
  -- ensure we only include shards that match the known shard suffix pattern (years)
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
  -- filter out rows lacking a valid station identifier or date parts
  AND g.stn IS NOT NULL
  AND g.year IS NOT NULL AND g.mo IS NOT NULL AND g.da IS NOT NULL
station_daily_observations_raw.description: All raw daily/per-observation weather measurements recorded at weather stations, filtered to measurements for station identifiers present (no question-specific date or year filters). This selects the base observation rows including timestamp/date, station id (usaf), temperature, wind speed, and precipitation fields as recorded in the source table(s).

june_12_dates_cohort.name: june_12_dates_cohort
june_12_dates_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  DATE(year_val, 6, 12) AS date,
  year_val AS year
FROM (
  -- generate years between two bounds; lift literals out of view when used by queries
  -- Replace @start_year and @end_year with desired integer bounds when querying the view
  SELECT year_val
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(COALESCE(@start_year, 1900), COALESCE(@end_year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE())))) AS year_val
)
june_12_dates_cohort.description: Cohort of calendar dates corresponding to June 12 for a range of years. Produces date rows for each year-month-day combination (one row per date). This is a generic date-cohort generator for selecting month=6 and day=12 dates across years.

icoads_core_monthly_means_valid.name: icoads_core_monthly_means_valid
icoads_core_monthly_means_valid.body_sql:
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  AVG(NULLIF(air_temperature, 0)) AS avg_air_temperature_c,
  AVG(NULLIF(wetbulb_temperature, 0)) AS avg_wetbulb_temperature_c,
  AVG(NULLIF(dewpoint_temperature, 0)) AS avg_dewpoint_temperature_c,
  AVG(NULLIF(sea_surface_temp, 0)) AS avg_sea_surface_temp_c
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2005' AND '2017'
GROUP BY
  year,
  month
HAVING
  -- require all four monthly means to be present (non-NULL)
  COUNTIF(air_temperature IS NOT NULL) > 0
  AND COUNTIF(wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL) > 0
  AND COUNTIF(dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL) > 0
  AND COUNTIF(sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL) > 0
icoads_core_monthly_means_valid.description: Filter monthly-mean rows to only those year-months where all four monthly means are present (non-NULL), producing a clean cohort of months usable for pairwise comparisons.

monthly_pairwise_abs_differences.name: monthly_pairwise_abs_differences
monthly_pairwise_abs_differences.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
  CAST(month AS INT64) AS month,
  -- sum of absolute differences across all distinct pairs of the four monthly mean variables:
  -- variables (monthly means) are: mean_temp, mean_dewp, mean_slp, mean_visib
  -- lift literals (table suffix range) out of view; this view expects a driving query to supply/filter _TABLE_SUFFIX when querying the underlying gsod shards.
  (
    ABS(mean_temp - mean_dewp)
    + ABS(mean_temp - mean_slp)
    + ABS(mean_temp - mean_visib)
    + ABS(mean_dewp - mean_slp)
    + ABS(mean_dewp - mean_visib)
    + ABS(mean_slp - mean_visib)
  ) AS sum_of_abs_differences
FROM (
  -- compute monthly means per station-day records aggregated into year/month monthly means
  -- across the date-sharded GSOD tables. Caller should restrict _TABLE_SUFFIX as needed.
  SELECT
    CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
    CAST(mo AS INT64) AS month,
    -- monthly means across all valid daily records (exclude missing sentinel values like 9999.9 or 999.9 or 99.99)
    AVG(NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(temp, 9999.9), 999.9), 99.99)) AS mean_temp,
    AVG(NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(dewp, 9999.9), 999.9), 99.99)) AS mean_dewp,
    AVG(NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(slp, 9999.9), 999.9), 99.99)) AS mean_slp,
    AVG(NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(visib, 9999.9), 999.9), 99.99)) AS mean_visib
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE TRUE
    -- NOTE: restrict shards when selecting the view, e.g. WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
    AND dewp IS NOT NULL
    AND slp IS NOT NULL
    AND visib IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, mo
)
monthly_pairwise_abs_differences.description: For each year-month, compute absolute differences between each distinct pair of the four monthly mean variables and sum those absolute differences to produce a single metric per month.

icoads_observations_filtered.name: icoads_observations_filtered
icoads_observations_filtered.body_sql:
SELECT
  TIMESTAMP(
    SAFE_CAST(year AS STRING) || '-' ||
    LPAD(SAFE_CAST(month AS STRING),2,'0') || '-' ||
    LPAD(SAFE_CAST(day AS STRING),2,'0') ||
    ' ' ||
    LPAD(SAFE_CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hour) AS INT64) AS STRING),2,'0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(SAFE_CAST(CAST(FLOOR((hour - FLOOR(hour)) * 60) AS INT64) AS STRING),2,'0') || ':00'
  ) AS timestamp,
  year,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  -- wind_speed is stored in tenths of m/s per DDL; convert to m/s
  SAFE_DIVIDE(wind_speed, 10.0) AS wind_speed
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2005' AND '2017'
  AND wind_speed IS NOT NULL
  AND year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2017
icoads_observations_filtered.description: Row-level subset of ICOADS core observations from the sharded tables for the ICOADS dataset, excluding records with missing wind_speed and keeping only observations within the broader target year range. This prepares the raw observation cohort for downstream processing.

icoads_observation_dates.name: icoads_observation_dates
icoads_observation_dates.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical UTC date derived from timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD)
  CAST(DATE(timestamp) AS STRING) AS observation_date,
  -- canonical numeric latitude/longitude (preserve original precision)
  latitude AS latitude,
  longitude AS longitude,
  -- wind speed: use available numeric wind fields if present; icoads uses various wind speed fields.
  -- Keep as numeric (meters per second if already; but source units may vary — lift unit decisions out of view)
  -- Prefer a generic 'wind_speed' field if present; fall back to NULL if not.
  -- Here we select the column named 'ship_speed' when available, else NULL.
  SAFE_CAST(NULLIF(CAST(ship_speed AS STRING), '') AS FLOAT64) AS wind_speed,
  -- preserve original timestamp for grain and joining
  TIMESTAMP(timestamp) AS timestamp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000`
WHERE
  -- keep only rows that have a non-null timestamp and sensible lat/lon
  timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND longitude IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CAST(DATE(TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), "-", LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING),2,'0'), "-", LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING),2,'0')))) AS STRING) AS observation_date,
  latitude AS latitude,
  longitude AS longitude,
  SAFE_CAST(NULLIF(CAST(ship_speed AS STRING), '') AS FLOAT64) AS wind_speed,
  -- construct a timestamp when only date/time fields present; set hour to fractional 'hour' when available
  TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), "-", LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING),2,'0'), "-", LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING),2,'0'),
                   " ",
                   LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(CAST(FLOOR(hour) AS INT64),0) AS STRING),2,'0'),
                   ":",
                   LPAD(CAST(CAST(ROUND( (hour - FLOOR(hour)) * 60 ) AS INT64) AS STRING),2,'0'),
                   ":00")) AS timestamp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2001' AND '2017'
  AND year IS NOT NULL
  AND month IS NOT NULL
  AND day IS NOT NULL
  AND latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND longitude IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  -- for older shard range
  CAST(DATE(TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), "-", LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING),2,'0'), "-", LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING),2,'0')))) AS STRING) AS observation_date,
  latitude AS latitude,
  longitude AS longitude,
  SAFE_CAST(NULLIF(CAST(ship_speed AS STRING), '') AS FLOAT64) AS wind_speed,
  TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), "-", LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING),2,'0'), "-", LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING),2,'0'),
                   " ",
                   LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(CAST(FLOOR(hour) AS INT64),0) AS STRING),2,'0'),
                   ":",
                   LPAD(CAST(CAST(ROUND( (hour - FLOOR(hour)) * 60 ) AS INT64) AS STRING),2,'0'),
                   ":00")) AS timestamp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_1662_2000`
WHERE
  year IS NOT NULL
  AND month IS NOT NULL
  AND day IS NOT NULL
  AND latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND longitude IS NOT NULL
icoads_observation_dates.description: Normalized observation rows that derive a canonical UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) from the observation timestamp and canonicalize latitude/longitude types to consistent numeric formats. Keeps one row per original observation with the derived date for grouping.

gsod_daily_temps_clean.name: gsod_daily_temps_clean
gsod_daily_temps_clean.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.usaf AS usaf,
  s.wban AS wban,
  CONCAT(g.year, g.mo, g.da) AS yearday,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(g.year, g.mo, g.da)) AS date,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(g.temp, 9999.9), CAST(9999.9 AS FLOAT64)) AS tavg,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(g.max, 9999.9), CAST(9999.9 AS FLOAT64)) AS tmax,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(g.min, 9999.9), CAST(9999.9 AS FLOAT64)) AS tmin,
  ( (NULLIF(NULLIF(g.temp, 9999.9), CAST(9999.9 AS FLOAT64)) IS NOT NULL)
    AND (NULLIF(NULLIF(g.max, 9999.9), CAST(9999.9 AS FLOAT64)) IS NOT NULL)
    AND (NULLIF(NULLIF(g.min, 9999.9), CAST(9999.9 AS FLOAT64)) IS NOT NULL)
  ) AS all_temps_valid
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS g
LEFT JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
ON
  s.usaf = g.stn
  AND s.wban = g.wban
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
gsod_daily_temps_clean.description: Cleaned daily GSOD observations with canonical date and temperature validity markers; canonicalize temperature NULLs and sentinel values (e.g., 9999.9) to NULL and expose a boolean indicating whether all three temperature fields are valid for that day.

stations_cohort.name: stations_cohort
stations_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  usaf,
  wban,
  name AS station_name,
  lat AS latitude,
  lon AS longitude
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
WHERE
  -- exclude placeholder/invalid USAF codes:
  -- common invalid placeholders are empty string, '000000' or strings of zeros; keep only non-null, non-empty, non-all-zero values
  usaf IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(usaf) <> ''
  AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(usaf, r'^[0]*$') = FALSE
stations_cohort.description: Cohort of stations from the stations table filtered to exclude placeholder/invalid USAF codes; one row per station identity (USAF, WBAN).

station_yearly_valid_day_counts.name: station_yearly_valid_day_counts
station_yearly_valid_day_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.usaf AS usaf,
  s.wban AS wban,
  CAST(gsod.year AS INT64) AS calendar_year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN SAFE_CAST(gsod.temp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL AND gsod.temp != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_day_count,
  COUNT(1) AS total_day_count
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS gsod
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
ON
  gsod.stn = s.usaf
  AND IFNULL(gsod.wban, '') = IFNULL(s.wban, '')
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
GROUP BY
  s.usaf,
  s.wban,
  CAST(gsod.year AS INT64)
station_yearly_valid_day_counts.description: For each station (USAF, WBAN) and calendar year, compute counts of valid observation days and total possible days in that year (calendar-year denominator should be applied later as needed); uses cleaned daily temperature validity flags to aggregate per station-year.

station_yearly_completeness_flag.name: station_yearly_completeness_flag
station_yearly_completeness_flag.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.usaf AS usaf,
  s.wban AS wban,
  CAST(g.year AS INT64) AS calendar_year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN SAFE_CAST(g.temp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(g.temp AS FLOAT64) != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_day_count,
  COUNT(1) AS total_day_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN SAFE_CAST(g.temp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(g.temp AS FLOAT64) != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(1)
  ) AS completeness_fraction
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS g
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
ON
  g.stn = s.usaf
  AND g.wban = s.wban
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
GROUP BY
  s.usaf,
  s.wban,
  g.year
station_yearly_completeness_flag.description: Per-station-per-year boolean/computed measure indicating data completeness (fraction or flag) derived from valid and total day counts; emits numeric completeness_fraction and an optional boolean completeness_flag left for thresholding by the final query.

wa_stations.name: wa_stations
wa_stations.body_sql:
SELECT
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.usaf AS usaf,
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.wban AS wban,
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.name AS name,
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.state AS state
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
WHERE
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`.state = 'WA'
wa_stations.description: Subset of stations located in Washington State. Includes one row per station with its identifiers and stored state value; canonicalize but do not alter stored state values.

daily_precip_records.name: daily_precip_records
daily_precip_records.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.usaf AS usaf,
  s.wban AS wban,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(g.year, LPAD(g.mo,2,'0'), LPAD(g.da,2,'0'))) AS obs_date,
  -- Convert inches to millimeters (1 inch = 25.4 mm)
  -- prcp uses 99.99 as missing sentinel; exclude NULLs and sentinel in WHERE
  CAST(ROUND(g.prcp * 25.4, 2) AS FLOAT64) AS precip_mm
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS g
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
ON
  g.stn = s.usaf
  AND g.wban = s.wban
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
  AND g.prcp IS NOT NULL
  AND g.prcp != 99.99
  -- Also exclude any non-numeric or negative precipitation values if present
  AND SAFE_CAST(g.prcp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
  AND g.prcp >= 0
daily_precip_records.description: Normalized daily precipitation observations per station-day with precipitation cleaned: exclude sentinel 99.99 and NULLs, ensure date column and numeric precipitation value. One row per station-day observation.

gsod_2023_october_rows.name: gsod_2023_october_rows
gsod_2023_october_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  stn,
  wban,
  year,
  mo,
  da,
  temp,
  max,
  min
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2023'
  AND year = '2023'
  AND mo = '10'
  -- exclude sentinel/missing temperature values per DDL (missing = 9999.9)
  AND temp IS NOT NULL
  AND temp != 9999.9
  AND max IS NOT NULL
  AND max != 9999.9
  AND min IS NOT NULL
  AND min != 9999.9
gsod_2023_october_rows.description: Row-level subset of GSOD observations for year 2023 and month October, excluding rows with missing sentinel temperature values. This returns raw gsod rows (no joins) for the target month/year, usable for downstream joins and aggregations.

stations_core.name: stations_core
stations_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.usaf AS usaf,
  s.wban AS wban,
  -- Normalize country: uppercase, trim; keep NULLs as NULL
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(UPPER(s.country)) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE TRIM(UPPER(s.country))
  END AS country
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
stations_core.description: Canonical subset of the stations table with station identifiers and country code normalized for country comparisons. Keeps station identification columns and country; intended to be joined to GSOD rows by station identifiers.

gsod_with_country.name: gsod_with_country
gsod_with_country.body_sql:
SELECT
  g.stn AS stn,
  g.wban AS wban,
  g.year AS year,
  g.mo AS mo,
  g.da AS da,
  g.temp AS temp,
  g.max AS max,
  g.min AS min,
  s.country AS country
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS g
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
  ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '2023'
  AND g.mo = '10'
gsod_with_country.description: Denormalized GSOD rows for 2023 October enriched with station country by joining GSOD subset to stations on station identifiers (gsod.stn = stations.usaf AND gsod.wban = stations.wban).

daily_country_temperature_aggregates.name: daily_country_temperature_aggregates
daily_country_temperature_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT
  PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', LPAD(mo,2,'0'), '-', LPAD(da,2,'0'))) AS date,
  stations.country AS country,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(max, 9999.9), 9999.9) AS daily_max_temp,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(min, 9999.9), 9999.9) AS daily_min_temp,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(temp, 9999.9), 9999.9) AS daily_avg_temp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS g
LEFT JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS stations
ON
  g.stn = stations.usaf
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @gsod_start_year AND @gsod_end_year
  AND year IS NOT NULL
  -- only include rows where at least one of the temperature fields is present (not the missing sentinel)
  AND (NULLIF(max, 9999.9) IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(min, 9999.9) IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(temp, 9999.9) IS NOT NULL)
daily_country_temperature_aggregates.description: Daily aggregated temperature measures (daily max of 'max', daily min of 'min', daily average of 'temp') computed per date and per station country. One row per calendar date and country provides the aggregated values used to compute inter-country differences.

station_daily_observations.name: station_daily_observations
station_daily_observations.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical date as DATE type constructed from year/mo/da from GSOD shards
  PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(g.year, '-', LPAD(g.mo,2,'0'), '-', LPAD(g.da,2,'0'))) AS date,
  -- station identifier: use WMO/DATSAV3 station number if present, else combine usaf+wban for uniqueness
  COALESCE(NULLIF(g.stn,''), CONCAT(g.stn, g.wban), CONCAT(COALESCE(s.usaf,''), '-', COALESCE(s.wban,''))) AS station_id,
  -- mean temperature: GSOD temp is in Fahrenheit to tenths, missing coded as 9999.9.
  -- convert to Celsius and set NULL for missing/unreasonable values.
  CASE
    WHEN g.temp IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN g.temp >= 9999 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND((g.temp - 32.0) * 5.0/9.0, 2)
  END AS temp_c,
  -- precipitation: GSOD prcp is inches (hundredths), missing = 99.99. Convert to centimeters.
  CASE
    WHEN g.prcp IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN g.prcp >= 99.99 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(g.prcp * 2.54, 2)
  END AS precip_cm,
  -- wind speed: gsod wdsp may be stored as STRING; gust/wdsp units are knots to tenths with missing = 999.9.
  -- Prefer numeric wdsp if parseable, else use gust converted from knots to m/s. Missing => NULL.
  CASE
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(g.wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(g.wdsp AS FLOAT64) < 999.9
      THEN ROUND(SAFE_CAST(g.wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444, 2)
    WHEN g.gust IS NOT NULL AND g.gust < 999.9
      THEN ROUND(g.gust * 0.514444, 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS wind_m_s
FROM
  -- query across all GSOD shards; caller should restrict _TABLE_SUFFIX via view consumer
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS g
LEFT JOIN
  -- join station metadata to help build consistent station_id when stn is missing
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
ON
  s.usaf = g.stn OR s.wban = g.wban
station_daily_observations.description: Canonical daily weather observations for each meteorological station and date: temperatures in Celsius, precipitation in centimeters, and wind speed in meters per second. Convert units and handle missing/nulls so each row has standardized numeric columns date, station_id, temp_c, precip_cm, wind_m_s.

station_daily_8day_moving_avg.name: station_daily_8day_moving_avg
station_daily_8day_moving_avg.body_sql:
-- view body: one row per station_id and date with 8-day moving averages
SELECT
  -- station identifier: prefer WMO/DATSAV3 station number when available (stn), else WBAN
  COALESCE(stn, wban) AS station_id,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0'))) AS date,
  -- 8-day moving average of mean daily air temp converted to Celsius (F -> C). Exclude missing sentinel 9999.9
  AVG(NULLIF((temp - 32.0) * 5.0/9.0, (9999.9 - 32.0) * 5.0/9.0)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY COALESCE(stn, wban)
    ORDER BY PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0')))
    ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS ma8_temp_c,
  -- 8-day moving average of daily precipitation converted from inches to centimeters (1 inch = 2.54 cm). Exclude missing sentinel 99.99
  AVG(NULLIF(prcp * 2.54, 99.99 * 2.54)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY COALESCE(stn, wban)
    ORDER BY PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0')))
    ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS ma8_precip_cm,
  -- 8-day moving average of mean wind speed converted from knots to m/s (1 knot = 0.514444 m/s).
  -- wdsp stored as STRING in DDL; cast to FLOAT64 and exclude missing sentinel 999.9
  AVG(
    NULLIF(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444, 999.9 * 0.514444)
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY COALESCE(stn, wban)
    ORDER BY PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0')))
    ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS ma8_wind_m_s
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
-- lift shard range filter out of the view; callers must supply a _TABLE_SUFFIX filter when querying the view
-- filter out rows that have no date information
WHERE
  SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0'))) IS NOT NULL
station_daily_8day_moving_avg.description: For each station_id and date compute 8-day moving averages (including current day and previous 7 days) of temp_c, precip_cm, and wind_m_s using rows from canonical daily observations.

station_daily_observations.name: station_daily_observations
station_daily_observations.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.usaf AS usaf,
  s.wban AS wban,
  g.year AS year,
  g.mo AS month,
  g.da AS day,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(g.year, '-', LPAD(g.mo,2,'0'), '-', LPAD(g.da,2,'0'))) AS date,
  g.temp AS avg_temp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` AS s
JOIN
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*` AS g
ON
  s.usaf = g.stn
  AND ( (s.wban = g.wban) OR (s.wban IS NULL AND g.wban IS NULL) )
WHERE
  -- Lift these literals out of the view when querying the view:
  -- 1) Station identifiers: provide usaf and optional wban in the outer query to filter.
  -- 2) Shard range: filter _TABLE_SUFFIX in the outer query, e.g. WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
  -- Exclude rows missing the daily average temperature (missing value = 9999.9)
  g.temp IS NOT NULL
  AND g.temp != 9999.9
station_daily_observations.description: Subset of daily observation rows for a single station (by usaf and optional wban), keeping one row per station-day; excludes rows missing the daily average temperature value.

canonical_observation_date.name: canonical_observation_date
canonical_observation_date.body_sql:
SELECT
  stn AS usaf,
  wban AS wban,
  -- Build ISO date from year, month, day fields. Keep NULL if any component missing or placeholder.
  CASE
    WHEN year IS NULL OR mo IS NULL OR da IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN TRIM(year) = '' OR TRIM(mo) = '' OR TRIM(da) = '' THEN NULL
    -- Some shards store numeric strings; ensure zero-padded month/day of length 2
    ELSE CONCAT(
      LPAD(TRIM(year), 4, '0'), '-',
      LPAD(TRIM(mo), 2, '0'), '-',
      LPAD(TRIM(da), 2, '0')
    )
  END AS date,
  -- Extract numeric year/month/day as integers where possible; NULL when source missing or blank
  CASE WHEN year IS NULL OR TRIM(year) = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(TRIM(year) AS INT64) END AS year,
  CASE WHEN mo IS NULL OR TRIM(mo) = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(LPAD(TRIM(mo),2,'0') AS INT64) END AS month,
  CASE WHEN da IS NULL OR TRIM(da) = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(LPAD(TRIM(da),2,'0') AS INT64) END AS day,
  -- Canonical cleaned daily average temperature:
  -- temp uses sentinel 9999.9 for missing; convert to Celsius? Requirement asks numeric/NULL cleaned daily average temperature column.
  -- Keep in original Fahrenheit as numeric and NULL out sentinel/missing values.
  CASE
    WHEN temp IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) = 9999.9 THEN NULL
    ELSE SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64)
  END AS avg_temp
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
-- Lift date range filtering out of the view; users should filter using _TABLE_SUFFIX in queries that reference this view.
canonical_observation_date.description: Normalized ISO date string and separate year/month/day extracted from observation date components or fields, and a canonical numeric/NULL cleaned daily average temperature column.

nearby_stations.name: nearby_stations
nearby_stations.body_sql:
SELECT
  usaf,
  wban,
  name,
  lat,
  lon
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
nearby_stations.description: Subset of stations that are geographically near any query point. Each row is one station with its identifier, name and coordinates. Does not apply any question-specific distance literal.

gsod_valid_temps.name: gsod_valid_temps
gsod_valid_temps.body_sql:
SELECT
  stn,
  wban,
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS year,
  temp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE
  temp IS NOT NULL
  AND temp != 9999.9
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
gsod_valid_temps.description: Rows from the NOAA GSOD tables representing daily observations with valid temperature values (exclude NULL and the missing-sentinel 9999.9). Includes the station identifiers and year extracted from the table suffix.

station_daily_temp_counts.name: station_daily_temp_counts
station_daily_temp_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  stn,
  wban,
  year,
  COUNTIF(temp IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9) AS valid_temp_count
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
GROUP BY
  stn,
  wban,
  year
station_daily_temp_counts.description: For each station (by USAF and WBAN) and year, count of valid daily temperature observations. Aggregates gsod_valid_temps rows into counts per station-year.

daily_station_mean_temp.name: daily_station_mean_temp
daily_station_mean_temp.body_sql:
SELECT
  stn,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0'))) AS date,
  AVG(temp) AS daily_mean_temp
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN @start_year AND @end_year
  AND temp IS NOT NULL
  AND temp != 9999.9
GROUP BY
  stn,
  date

semantic_filters.valid_temp_exclusion: exclude sentinel/invalid temperature values such as 9999.9
semantic_filters.date_range: no intrinsic date filter here (caller may restrict)

daily_station_mean_temp.description: Compute one daily mean temperature per weather station and day, excluding invalid sentinel values (e.g., 9999.9). The row represents a single station-day with a canonical date and the station's daily mean temperature.

daily_jfk_avg_wind_speed.name: daily_jfk_avg_wind_speed
daily_jfk_avg_wind_speed.body_sql:
SELECT
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, LPAD(mo,2,'0'), LPAD(da,2,'0'))) AS date,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CAST(NULLIF(wdsp, '') AS FLOAT64)),  -- wdsp is stored as STRING in schema; treat empty as NULL
    COUNTIF(NULLIF(wdsp, '') IS NOT NULL)
  ) AS avg_wind_speed_knots
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
  AND stn = '744860'  -- carry station identifier filter (usaf = '744860' corresponds to stn)
  AND wdsp IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(wdsp, '') != ''
  AND wdsp NOT IN ('999.9')  -- missing sentinel
GROUP BY
  date
ORDER BY
  date
daily_jfk_avg_wind_speed.description: For each calendar date, compute the daily average wind speed (in knots) from GSOD observations for the station identified by usaf = '744860'.

complaint_type_total_counts.name: complaint_type_total_counts
complaint_type_total_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  complaint_type,
  COUNT(1) AS total_count
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
GROUP BY
  complaint_type
complaint_type_total_counts.description: For each complaint_type, compute the total number of 311 service requests in the dataset (used for filtering complaint types by overall volume).

nyc_zip_polygons.name: nyc_zip_polygons
nyc_zip_polygons.body_sql:
SELECT
  zip_code,
  zip_code_geom AS zip_geom
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
WHERE
  state_name = 'New York'
  AND (city LIKE '%New York%' OR city LIKE '%Brooklyn%' OR city LIKE '%Queens%' OR city LIKE '%Bronx%' OR city LIKE '%Staten Island%' OR county IN ('New York','Kings','Queens','Bronx','Richmond'))
  AND zip_code IS NOT NULL
  AND zip_code != ''
nyc_zip_polygons.description: All NYC ZIP code polygons and their identifiers drawn from the canonical zip code boundaries table, limited to ZIPs that are considered part of New York City in the source table. This produces one row per ZIP polygon for spatial mapping.

station_daily_valid_observations.name: station_daily_valid_observations
station_daily_valid_observations.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  date,
  element,
  value,
  mflag,
  qflag,
  sflag
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1763' AND '2024' -- liftable literal: date shard range
  AND value IS NOT NULL
  AND (qflag IS NULL OR qflag = '')
station_daily_valid_observations.description: All validated (no quality flags and non-null value) daily observations for stations, normalized to one row per original observation record. This filters out records with NULL measurement values or any quality flags indicating invalid data.

station_december_17_31_observations.name: station_december_17_31_observations
station_december_17_31_observations.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.id AS id,
  s.date AS date,
  s.element AS element,
  -- convert precipitation from tenths of mm to mm for PRCP, temperatures from tenths of °C to °C for TMIN/TMAX
  CASE
    WHEN s.element = 'PRCP' THEN s.value / 10.0
    WHEN s.element IN ('TMIN','TMAX') THEN s.value / 10.0
    ELSE s.value
  END AS converted_value
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*` AS s
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1763' AND '2024'
  -- filter to December 17 through December 31 (any year)
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.date) = 12
  AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM s.date) BETWEEN 17 AND 31
  -- keep only rows that are not flagged as invalid by qflag (NULL or empty means OK)
  AND (s.qflag IS NULL OR s.qflag = '')

semantic_filters.date_day_of_year: between 351 and 365 OR (handle leap-year mapping to Dec 17-31 explicitly)

station_december_17_31_observations.description: Subset of daily observations that fall in the calendar window December 17 through December 31 (any year). This is a reusable cohort representing 'last 15 days of December' observation rows for stations.

station_yearly_december_peak_metrics.name: station_yearly_december_peak_metrics
station_yearly_december_peak_metrics.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value END) AS max_precip_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value END) AS min_temp_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value END) AS max_temp_c
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1763' AND '2024'
  AND date BETWEEN DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS STRING), '-12-17'))
               AND DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS STRING), '-12-31'))
  AND qflag IS NULL
GROUP BY id, year
station_yearly_december_peak_metrics.description: For each station and calendar year, compute aggregate peak metrics over the December 17-31 window: maximum PRCP (mm), minimum TMIN (°C), and maximum TMAX (°C). One row per station-year summarizing those three peak values.

ghcnd_prcp_daily_measurements.name: ghcnd_prcp_daily_measurements
ghcnd_prcp_daily_measurements.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  date,
  value AS value_raw,
  -- Per GHCN documentation PRCP values are in tenths of mm, so convert to mm
  -- (Lifted constant: 0.1) 
  value * 0.1 AS precip_mm,
  mflag,
  sflag,
  qflag
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE element = 'PRCP'
  AND qflag IS NULL
  -- Note: _TABLE_SUFFIX filtering should be applied by the query using this view if needed.
ghcnd_prcp_daily_measurements.description: Daily GHCN precipitation (PRCP) measurements (raw value and converted mm) for all stations and all dates; include only rows where element = 'PRCP' and qflag IS NULL. Do not restrict to a specific date range or station here.

daily_citibike_trip_counts.name: daily_citibike_trip_counts
daily_citibike_trip_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  DATE(starttime) AS start_date,
  COUNT(1) AS daily_trip_count
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
GROUP BY
  start_date
ORDER BY
  start_date
daily_citibike_trip_counts.description: Aggregate citibike trips to produce one row per calendar date (UTC) with the total number of trips that started that date. This is a general daily trips-per-date view (no year filter).

citibike_trip_events_filtered.name: citibike_trip_events_filtered
citibike_trip_events_filtered.body_sql:
SELECT
  SAFE_CAST(GENERATE_UUID() AS STRING) AS trip_id,
  CAST(start_station_id AS STRING) AS start_station_id,
  CAST(end_station_id AS STRING) AS end_station_id,
  starttime,
  end_station_name
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
WHERE
  start_station_id IS NOT NULL
  AND end_station_id IS NOT NULL
  AND starttime IS NOT NULL
citibike_trip_events_filtered.description: Filtered subset of citibike_trips containing only rows with non-null start and end station ids and non-null starttime; retains original trip-level columns for further analysis.

station_end_counts.name: station_end_counts
station_end_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(end_station_id AS INT64) AS end_station_id,
  end_station_name,
  COUNT(1) AS total_trips_ending_at_station
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
GROUP BY
  end_station_id,
  end_station_name
station_end_counts.description: For each end station (by id and name), compute the total number of trips that end at that station. One row per end station.

tree_species_normalized.name: tree_species_normalized
tree_species_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  species_scientific_name,
  UPPER(species_scientific_name) AS species_scientific_name_up,
  fall_color
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
GROUP BY
  species_scientific_name,
